run_ppo_continuous: run PPO reinforcement learning on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2
build_experiment_config: build a PPO experiment config with normalized advantage and value for continuous control tasks
run_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed PPO experiment with 64 actors using launchpad and Docker resources
run_single_threaded_experiment: run a single-threaded PPO experiment with periodic evaluation every 50000 steps
configure_ppo_network: configure PPO networks with three 256-unit hidden layers for a given environment spec
